package main

import (
	"context"
	"fmt"
	"time"

	"github.com/AtomiCloud/diene.go-auth-engine/lib/authengine"
	"github.com/AtomiCloud/diene.go-auth-engine/lib/deferred"
	"github.com/AtomiCloud/diene.go-auth-engine/lib/logto"
	"github.com/AtomiCloud/diene.go-auth-engine/lib/onboard"
	"github.com/AtomiCloud/diene.go-auth-engine/testhelper"
	"github.com/AtomiCloud/diene.go-errors-problems/lib/problem"
)

func main() {
	ctx := context.Background()

	idp, _ := testhelper.NewFakeIDP(testhelper.FakeIDPOptions{
		Issuer:        testhelper.DefaultIssuer,
		Audience:      testhelper.DefaultAudience,
		KeyID:         testhelper.DefaultKeyID,
		KeyBits:       testhelper.DefaultKeyBits,
		Now:           testhelper.FixedNow(),
		ExtraProblems: nil,
	})
	problems := idp.Problems()
	_ = idp.Issuer()
	_ = idp.Audience()
	_ = idp.Keys()
	_ = idp.Clock()
	idp.Advance(0)
	access, _ := idp.MintAccessToken(testhelper.TokenRequest{Subject: testhelper.DefaultSubject})
	identity, _ := idp.MintIDToken(testhelper.TokenRequest{})

	validator, _ := idp.Validator()
	principal, _ := validator.Validate(ctx, access)
	_, _ = validator.ValidateIDToken(ctx, identity)
	_ = validator.Issuer()
	_, _ = validator.ExtractOnboarding(ctx, authengine.OnboardingTokens{
		Access: access, ID: identity, Authorization: principal.Subject,
	})

	claims := principal.Claims
	_, _ = claims.Text(authengine.ClaimSubject)
	_, _ = claims.Flag(authengine.ClaimEmailVerified)
	_, _ = claims.List(authengine.ClaimRoles)
	_, _ = claims.Space(authengine.ClaimScope)
	_, _ = claims.Instant(authengine.ClaimExpiry)
	_ = claims.Clone()
	_ = principal.HasRole("admin")
	_ = principal.HasScope("read:booking")
	_ = principal.Registered("alcohol-zinc")
	_ = authengine.RegistrationClaim("alcohol-zinc")
	_ = authengine.NewClaimMapper().Map(claims)

	_ = authengine.ProblemTypes()
	_ = problems.Registry()
	_, _ = problems.Catalog()
	_ = problems.Raise(authengine.ProblemTokenMalformed, "", nil)
	_ = problems.RaiseFrom(authengine.ProblemTokenExpired, nil, "", nil)
	fmt.Println(
		authengine.ProblemVersion,
		authengine.ProblemTokenSignatureInvalid,
		authengine.ProblemTokenIssuerMismatch,
		authengine.ProblemTokenAudienceMismatch,
		authengine.ProblemTokenClaimMissing,
		authengine.ProblemTokenSubjectMismatch,
		authengine.ProblemSigningKeyUnknown,
		authengine.ProblemResourceUnregistered,
		authengine.ProblemOwnershipDenied,
		authengine.ProblemPolicyUnknown,
		authengine.ProblemRegistrationMissing,
		authengine.ProblemDeferredTokenUnknown,
		authengine.ProblemDeferredTokenExpired,
		authengine.ProblemDeferredTokenConsumed,
		authengine.ProblemRefreshTokenReused,
		authengine.ProblemRefreshTokenUnknown,
		authengine.ProblemOnboardingStalled,
		authengine.ProblemHomeLandscapeUnresolved,
		authengine.ProblemProviderUnavailable,
		authengine.ProblemConfigInvalid,
		authengine.ClaimIssuer,
		authengine.ClaimAudience,
		authengine.ClaimUsername,
		authengine.ClaimEmail,
		authengine.ClaimHomeLandscape,
		authengine.AccessTokenLifetime,
		authengine.RefreshTokenLifetime,
		authengine.DeferredTokenLifetime,
		authengine.OneTimeTokenLifetime,
		authengine.DefaultRefreshSkew,
		authengine.DefaultClockSkew,
		authengine.DefaultAlgorithms,
		authengine.DefaultTokenNamespace,
		authengine.DefaultTokenConcurrency,
		authengine.DefaultHandoffPath,
		authengine.ConfigBlockKey,
	)

	config := authengine.Config{
		IDP: authengine.IDPConfig{
			Issuer:  idp.Issuer(),
			JWKSURI: "https://idp.invalid/jwks",
			Management: authengine.ManagementConfig{
				Endpoint: "https://idp.invalid",
				Resource: "https://management.invalid",
				ClientID: "management",
			},
		},
		Minting: authengine.MintingConfig{
			TokenEndpoint: "https://idp.invalid/token",
			ClientID:      "zinc",
		},
		Resources: []authengine.ResourceConfig{
			{Name: "alcohol-zinc", Indicator: "https://api.zinc.invalid", Scopes: nil},
		},
		Policies: authengine.PolicySet{
			"OnlyAdmin": {Kind: authengine.PolicyAll, Field: authengine.ClaimRoles, Target: []string{"admin"}},
		},
	}
	_ = config.IDP.Leeway()
	_ = config.Minting.Skew()
	_ = config.Minting.Mount()
	_ = authengine.ConfigBlockSchema()
	tree, _ := config.Tree(problems)
	_ = tree.Resources()
	_ = tree.Names()
	_, _ = tree.Lookup("alcohol-zinc")
	resource, _ := tree.Require("alcohol-zinc")

	provider := testhelper.NewFakeProvider(testhelper.FakeProviderOptions{Now: testhelper.FixedNow()})
	provider.EnqueueResourceTokenError(nil)
	provider.EnqueueRefreshError(nil)
	provider.EnqueueClientCredentialsError(nil)
	provider.EnqueueOneTimeTokenError(nil)
	provider.EnqueueClaimError(nil)
	_ = provider.Minted()
	_ = provider.ResourceTokenCalls()
	_ = provider.RefreshCalls()
	_ = provider.ClientCredentialsCalls()
	_ = provider.OneTimeTokenCalls()
	_ = provider.ClaimCalls()
	_ = testhelper.ErrFakeProvider

	session := authengine.Session{Subject: principal.Subject, RefreshToken: "refresh-1"}
	source := authengine.NewSessionSource(provider, session)
	_ = source.Session()
	_, _ = source.Mint(ctx, resource)
	machine := authengine.NewClientCredentialsSource(provider)
	_, _ = machine.Mint(ctx, resource)

	store := testhelper.NewMemoryTokenStore()
	store.EnqueueError(nil)
	_ = store.Keys()
	cache, _ := authengine.NewTokenCache(authengine.TokenCacheOptions{
		Tree: tree, Store: store, Source: machine, Problems: problems, Clock: idp.Clock(),
	})
	token, _ := cache.Token(ctx, "alcohol-zinc")
	_, _ = cache.All(ctx)
	_ = cache.Invalidate(ctx, "alcohol-zinc")
	_, _ = cache.Key("alcohol-zinc")
	_ = token.Expired(testhelper.FixedNow(), 0)
	_ = token.TTL(testhelper.FixedNow())

	refreshStore := testhelper.NewMemoryRefreshStore()
	refreshStore.EnqueueError(nil)
	_ = refreshStore.Records()
	rotator, _ := authengine.NewRotator(authengine.RotatorOptions{
		Provider: provider, Store: refreshStore, Problems: problems,
		Clock: idp.Clock(), Lifetime: authengine.RefreshTokenLifetime,
	})
	_ = rotator.Issue(ctx, session)
	_, _ = rotator.Rotate(ctx, "refresh-1")
	_, _ = rotator.Fingerprint("refresh-1")

	checker := authengine.ClaimScopeChecker{}
	_ = checker.Scope(principal, authengine.ClaimRoles)
	_ = checker.HasAny(principal, authengine.ClaimRoles, []string{"admin"})
	_ = checker.HasAll(principal, authengine.ClaimRoles, []string{"admin"})
	guard, _ := idp.Guard()
	_, _ = authengine.NewGuard(authengine.GuardOptions{
		Problems: problems, Checker: checker, Logs: nil, Clock: idp.Clock(),
	})
	target := principal.Subject
	_ = guard.Sub(principal, &target)
	_ = guard.SubOrAny(principal, &target, authengine.ClaimRoles, "admin")
	_ = guard.SubOrAll(principal, &target, authengine.ClaimRoles, "admin")
	_ = guard.Registered(principal, "alcohol-zinc")
	_ = guard.Policy(principal, config.Policies, "OnlyAdmin")
	_ = config.Policies.Names()
	_ = authengine.PolicyAny

	deferredStore := testhelper.NewMemoryDeferredStore()
	deferredStore.EnqueueError(nil)
	_ = deferredStore.Digests()
	minter, _ := deferred.NewMinter(deferred.MinterOptions{
		Store: deferredStore, Provider: provider, Problems: problems,
		Clock: idp.Clock(), Lifetime: authengine.DeferredTokenLifetime,
	})
	handoff, _ := minter.Mint(ctx, session, nil)
	_, _ = minter.Exchange(ctx, handoff.Token)
	_ = deferred.Digest(handoff.Token)
	_ = deferred.Nonce()
	referrer, _ := deferred.AndroidReferrer(handoff, "")
	_, _, _ = deferred.ParseAndroidReferrer(referrer)
	payload, _ := deferred.ClipboardPayload(handoff, "")
	_, _, _ = deferred.ParseClipboardPayload(payload)
	carrier := &deferred.CarrierError{Field: deferred.CarrierTokenField}
	fmt.Println(carrier.Error(), deferred.CarrierExpiryField, deferred.CarrierMountField, deferred.ClipboardMarker)
	_ = deferred.Record{
		Digest: "d", Subject: "s", Email: nil,
		IssuedAt: testhelper.FixedNow(), ExpiresAt: testhelper.FixedNow(), Consumed: false,
	}

	backend := testhelper.NewFakeBackend(testhelper.FakeBackendOptions{
		Name: "alcohol-zinc", Exists: false, NeedsConfiguration: false,
	})
	backend.EnqueueExistsError(nil)
	backend.EnqueueCreateError(nil)
	backend.EnqueueConfiguredError(nil)
	_ = backend.Registrations()
	_ = backend.Tokens()
	refresher := testhelper.NewFakeRefresher(principal)
	refresher.Enqueue(principal)
	refresher.EnqueueError(nil)
	_ = refresher.Calls()
	round, _ := onboard.NewSync(onboard.SyncOptions{
		Backends: []onboard.Backend{backend}, Claims: provider,
		Refresher: refresher, Tokens: cache, Problems: problems,
	})
	states, _ := round.Run(ctx, principal)
	_ = states["alcohol-zinc"].Ready()
	_ = onboard.ErrNoBackends
	_ = onboard.RawIDTokenClaim
	fmt.Println(
		onboard.PhasePreOnboarding, onboard.PhaseBootstrapping,
		onboard.PhaseNeedsOnboarding, onboard.PhaseReady, onboard.PhaseError,
	)

	pinger := testhelper.NewFakePinger()
	pinger.SetLatency("lapras", 1)
	pinger.SetError("mew", nil)
	_ = pinger.Calls()
	_, _ = pinger.Ping(ctx, onboard.Landscape{Name: "lapras", Healthy: true})
	_ = testhelper.ErrLandscapeUnreachable
	selector, _ := onboard.NewSelector(onboard.SelectorOptions{Pinger: pinger, Problems: problems})
	document := []onboard.Landscape{{Name: "lapras", Display: "SG", Region: "apac", Healthy: true}}
	home, _ := selector.Home(ctx, principal, document)
	_, _ = selector.Pick(ctx, document)
	_ = selector.Claim(ctx, provider, principal.Subject, home)

	client, _ := logto.NewClient(logto.ClientOptions{
		Config: config, HTTP: nil, Problems: problems, Clock: idp.Clock(),
	})
	_, _ = client.ResourceToken(ctx, authengine.ResourceTokenRequest{
		Subject: principal.Subject, RefreshToken: "refresh-1", Resource: resource,
	})
	_, _ = client.ClientCredentials(ctx, authengine.ClientCredentialsRequest{Resource: resource})
	_, _ = client.Refresh(ctx, "refresh-1")
	_, _ = client.MintOneTimeToken(ctx, authengine.OneTimeTokenRequest{Subject: principal.Subject})
	_ = client.SetClaim(ctx, principal.Subject, "alcohol_zinc", "true")
	keys, _ := logto.NewRemoteJWKS(ctx, config.IDP.JWKSURI, problems)
	_, _ = keys.Key(ctx, testhelper.DefaultKeyID)
	_, _ = logto.NewJWKS(nil, problems)

	_ = testhelper.SampleErrorPortal()
	_ = testhelper.HeaderKeyID
	_ = testhelper.ProblemID(problem.Problem{Type: "about:blank"})
	testhelper.AssertAuthProblem(reporter{}, nil, authengine.ProblemTokenExpired)
	testhelper.AssertNoAuthProblem(reporter{}, nil)
	testhelper.AssertOwnershipDenied(reporter{}, nil)
	testhelper.AssertPhase(reporter{}, states, "alcohol-zinc", onboard.PhaseReady)
	_, _ = testhelper.CheckAuthProblem(nil, "")
	_ = testhelper.CheckPhase(states, "alcohol-zinc", onboard.PhaseReady)
	_ = time.Second
}

// reporter satisfies testhelper.TestingT outside a test binary.
type reporter struct{}

func (reporter) Helper() {}

func (reporter) Fatalf(string, ...any) {}
